title: Confirms identity and pays the full amount today — a-paid-at-the-branch
script: You are Daniel Reyes, calm and sure this is already dealt with. Answer both security questions correctly: 'the fourteenth of March, eighty-eight' and 'four four, seven one'. I've got the receipt in my bag somewhere, if you want the number off it.' Ask when it comes off: 'when does that show up? I don't want it sitting on my file.' If the agent asks for a promise, say 'no — I've paid it. I'm not paying it twice.' Stay polite, do not get cross, and do not ask for a person.
